title: ICICI Adani One Signature credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A higher-tier Adani One Signature card delivering premium rewards, milestone vouchers, and lifestyle benefits within the Adani ecosystem.

mileStoneItems.benefits: For Prime Members: Get a welcome offer worth INR 2,500 along with 1-month Eazy Diner membership when you make a payment through Amazon.
